title: Add a first-class per-ticket testing plan field
objective: Add a structured test_plan field to tickets so each ticket carries its planned verification steps separately from acceptance criteria and the append-only tests execution ledger. Keep ticket-specific plans on the ticket rather than in parallel testing-plan documents.

acceptance_criteria.text: The test_plan field has a documented structure for host/guest test-environment setup (OS, hardware, prerequisites, workspace and credential safeguards), planned commands, expected results and stop conditions, clearly separate from acceptance criteria and tests.needed/created/cases. It defines how distinct test contexts can be assigned to subtickets when independently owned.
Ticket create, update, get/list/search and MCP tool schemas expose test_plan consistently; the design explicitly states whether/how independently testable subtickets can own their own setup and plan.
The engine defines compatibility for existing tickets and enforces the agreed requirement for newly created tickets without making legacy ticket reads/validation fail unexpectedly.
Automated engine, CLI and MCP tests cover creating, updating, validating and reading test_plan, including malformed or empty plans.
Documentation says ticket-specific test plans live on their tickets and execution evidence remains in the test ledger; no separate per-ticket plan document is introduced.

needed: Decide structured test_plan shape and whether it is required on new tickets
Update ticket-v1.json schema and engine normalizer/validation
Expose test_plan through CLI and MCP create/update/get surfaces
Add engine/CLI/MCP tests and legacy-ticket compatibility validation
Review ticket docs and remove conflicting guidance
Define host/environment setup as part of each test_plan, including separate host vs guest vs nested VM prerequisites when relevant
Decide whether subtickets need independent test_plan fields or reference a parent plan; current subtickets are not full tickets and do not yet have this field
cases: Owner clarification 2026-10-28: host setup/environment prerequisites belong on the ticket's test plan, not in a parallel setup document. Distinct, independently owned test contexts may be represented by subtickets, but the engine's current subtickets lack full ticket fields; #51 must decide and specify this.
